_readme: Differences between a role's shared section and the shared-rules source. Only roles that differ get an entry; a role not listed gets the source verbatim. Keys are agentIds from config/crew.json. Operations locate by section heading or fixed text, never by paragraph number. The sync script (scripts/sync-shared-rules.py) reads this file. Start/end markers are not stored here: the script takes the first line of shared-rules*.md as the start marker and the first line of shared-tail*.md as the end marker, one pair per language. Fields: reason = why the role differs; hasTail = false means this role's AGENTS.md has no tail (the shared section runs to the end of the file and the tail fingerprint is the empty string); ops = operations applied to the shared source, in order. Operation delete_section removes the section whose heading line equals the heading of the language in use (heading.<lang>); drop_final_blank_line removes the last blank line of the shared section.

desktop.reason: The Desktop operator has no 'Desktop' section: it is the desktop bot itself.

system-auditor.reason: The System auditor's AGENTS.md has no tail section (no changed-files list): its shared section runs to the end of the file and ends one blank line earlier than the source. The tail fingerprint is recorded as empty (zero bytes); it is still checked.
